home.intro1: This blog is a study journal — not about memorizing concepts, but understanding, implementing, and recording them. The focus is on
home.introEmphasis: why things work the way they do
home.dsBody: Stacks, queues, trees, graphs — starting from why each structure exists and what problem it was designed to solve. Organized by implementing each to understand the internals.
home.algoBody: Sorting, searching, dynamic programming, greedy. Rather than memorizing formulas, we think through when each algorithm is effective and why that approach is efficient.
home.csBody: OS, networking, databases, and language internals. Understanding how code executes in places you can't see changes how you look at every line you write.
